candidates: In a dependency-upgrade PR, flag any changes to source files or configuration files that go beyond package manifest updates and mechanical API-migration fixes (e.g., renamed types, updated call signatures). Ask the author to confirm each such change is intentional and explain why it is part of the upgrade, rather than an incidental side-effect of the tooling change.

Avoid combining an existence check with a side-effecting operation in a single conditional expression. Separate them into distinct statements — first check, then act — so each step is independently readable and the side effect cannot be accidentally triggered as part of the evaluation of a predicate.
Proofread prose in source-code comments (inline comments, JSDoc blocks, vitest/jest config file comments, etc.) for grammatical errors and typos before approving.
